who: Sam, a second-year HCI master's student. Builds a side project (Quorum) and interns at a payments company (Northwind). Codes in Claude Code and Codex, writes and asks everyday things in ChatGPT.

items.text: Writes in a plain, warm tone with short sentences; dislikes words like 'thrilled' or 'excited to announce'
Prefers bullet-point summaries over long paragraphs
Uses pnpm, never npm or yarn
Uses Vitest with test files next to the source
Commit messages are short and imperative, no feat:/fix: prefixes
When choosing between libraries, wants a short trade-off table before deciding
Quorum is a web app that finds a meeting time for student clubs from everyone's calendar
Quorum is built with Next.js and Supabase
Quorum has 140 weekly users across 9 clubs

changes.text: Quorum has 180 weekly users across 12 clubs after the v0.4 launch

items.text: Applying to product manager internships for summer 2027
